meta.promptText: Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye India mein konsa vitamin C serum kharidun?

response.text:
Agar aap **dark spots + dull skin** ke liye India mein vitamin C serum lena chahte ho, to practical choice usually **10% vitamin C serum** hota hai; beginners ke liye ye stable aur less-irritating option mana jaata hai, aur morning use ke saath sunscreen best rehta hai.[3]  
Agar **stubborn pigmentation/dark spots** hain aur skin vitamin C tolerate karti hai, to **15%** tak ja sakte ho.[3]

**Best picks from the results:**
- **Pilgrim 10% Vitamin C Face Serum** — overall safe starting point for brightness, pigmentation aur dull skin; source ne ise dull skin aur dark spots ke liye strong option bataya hai.[13][3]
- **Minimalist 10% Advanced Vitamin C Serum** — a commonly recommended 10% option for glowing skin, useful if you want a simple, beginner-friendly formula.[16][3]
- **Foxtale Vitamin C Serum (15% L-Ascorbic Acid)** — better fit if aapko zyada visible pigmentation fading chahiye aur aap stronger formula tolerate kar sakte ho.[14][3]
- **Biotique Vitamin C Dark Spot Solution Serum** — dark spots and dullness target karta hai, but broader expert-style guidance in the results still favors stable 10% formulas first for many users.[9][3]

**Meri short recommendation:**
- **Pehli baar vitamin C use kar rahe ho:** **Pilgrim 10%** ya **Minimalist 10%**
- **Skin already accustomed hai aur spots stubborn hain:** **Foxtale 15%**
- **Budget/basic dark spot focus:** **Biotique**  
These choices align with the idea that vitamin C helps reduce pigmentation, brighten dull skin, and even out tone, especially when used consistently with sunscreen.[3][12][19]

**Kaise use karein:**
- Subah face wash ke baad serum lagao.
- Uske baad moisturizer aur **SPF 30+ sunscreen** zaroor use karo, warna dark spots improve hone mein time lagega.[3][11]
- Results usually kuch weeks me dikhte hain; dullness pe pehle aur pigmentation pe thoda longer lag sakta hai.[11][8]

Agar aap chaho, main **budget ke hisaab se 3 best options** bhi shortlist kar dunga: **under ₹500, under ₹1000, aur premium**.
